basic_details.job_title: NIT Goa Assistant Librarian Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is Not Exceeding 35 Years.

qualification.details: Desirable: (1) PG Diploma in Library Automation and Networking or PGDCA or equivalent. (2) Candidate with higher degree (Ph. D. or equivalent) in a relevant Discipline shall be preferred.

selection_process: The selection process comprises shortlisting of applications based on Institute requirements and norms
how_to_apply: Duly fill the required data in the attached application form format provided in the notification PDF.
Compile the filled application form along with scanned copies of original documents, published papers (if any), etc. into a single *.pdf file.
Access the Google form link via the official notification to submit your application.
Attach the compiled *.pdf file in the provided space for Assistant Librarian on Temporary Basis in the Google Form.
Submit the application via the Google Form on or before 23-10-2026.
important_instructions: The appointment is for a period of six months on a purely temporary basis, which may be extended for another six months based on satisfactory performance. Incomplete application forms will not be considered for shortlisting. Fulfillment of essential qualifications does not entitle any candidate for an interview call. The test/interview will be conducted in Offline Mode, and timings will be shared via email after scrutiny. Selected candidates must be ready to join immediately as per Institute rules. All correspondences will be through email only; applicants are advised to regularly check their email.

content_sections.heading: NIT Goa Assistant Librarian Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable: (1) PG Diploma in Library Automation and Networking or PGDCA or equivalent. (2) Candidate with higher degree (Ph. D. or equivalent) in a relevant Discipline shall be preferred.

rows.qualification_required: (1) Master's Degree in Library Science/ Information Science/ Documentation Science with at least 60% marks or an equivalent Professional degree or its equivalent with equivalent grade (6.5 in 10 point scale) or its equivalent grade of 'B' in the UGC seven point scale and a consistently good academic record with superior knowledge of computerized library service.(2) Qualifying in the national level test such as NET/SLET/SET conducted for the purposed by UGC or any other agency approved by UGC.

content_sections.heading: NIT Goa Assistant Librarian Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is Not Exceeding 35 Years .

content_sections.heading: NIT Goa Assistant Librarian Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises shortlisting of applications based on Institute requirements and norms, followed by an offline test/interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Goa Assistant Librarian
content_sections.text: Duly fill the required data in the attached application form format provided in the notification PDF. Compile the filled application form along with scanned copies of original documents, published papers (if any), etc. into a single *.pdf file. Access the Google form link via the official notification to submit your application. Attach the compiled *.pdf file in the provided space for Assistant Librarian on Temporary Basis in the Google Form. Submit the application via the Google Form on or before 23-10-2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application form Original educational certificates and mark sheets/transcripts/grade cards Published papers (if any) Supporting documents for achievements, extracurricular activities, and experience

content_sections.heading: NIT Goa Assistant Librarian Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is for a period of six months on a purely temporary basis, which may be extended for another six months based on satisfactory performance. Incomplete application forms will not be considered for shortlisting. Fulfillment of essential qualifications does not entitle any candidate for an interview call.
